_comment: Checked-in stand-in for the run-time-staged `cli_reg_record.json`, used ONLY by test/DeployGuards.t.sol so the production settlement deployer (`script/DeployCloseCli.s.sol`) can be EXECUTED inside `forge test`. The real record is written by `channel_member export-reg-record` and copied into this directory by the Rust drivers, so it is untracked; `foundry.toml` fs_permissions are read-only, so a test cannot synthesize it at run time. Schema-identical to that record. The key material is arbitrary but must satisfy IntmaxRollup.registerChannel: at least MIN_CHANNEL_MEMBERS active participants, pairwise-distinct nonzero member_pk_gs, nonzero regev_pk_digests, nonzero recipients, and bp_member_slot < member_count. NOT a proving artifact: no proof is verified against it. Two INDEPENDENT delegate counts (see contracts/script/RegRecordLib.sol): `reg_delegate_count` is the L1 REGISTRATION record's and is always 0 (cosigner-only registration is a circuit constraint in channel_reg_step.rs, so a nonzero one is unprovable); `active_delegate_count` is the LIVE count the settlement manager binds (B-2 close floor + delegate recipient bindings). Both are 0 for the CLI record, for those two different reasons.
